metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Gobi Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) product (e.g., MODIS/006/MCD19A2_GRANULES or MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES) - Compare February 2020 vs February 2019 - Location: Gobi Desert (approximately centered around 42°N, 105°E) - Date ranges: 2019-02-01 to 2019-02-28 and 2020-02-01 to 2020-02-29 2. Masking strategy: - AOD data typically comes with QA bands - Should apply QA masking to get high-quality pixels only - The question is about AOD values, not clouds, so mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection sizes for both years - Check valid pixel counts after QA masking - AOD typically ranges 0-5 (valid range), negative or None = C3 - Compare mean AOD values: if 2020 > 2019 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Gobi Desert region (approximate center and bounds) const gobiDesert = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[100, 38], [110, 38], [110, 46], [100, 46], [100, 38]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS AOD data for both periods const aod2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') .filterBounds(gobiDesert) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); const aod2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') .filterBounds(gobiDesert) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); const size2019 = await aod2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = await aod2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); // 3. Check if collections are empty if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('Empty collection detected.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Create median composites and scale AOD values const aod2019Mean = aod2019.mean().multiply(0.001); // Scale factor const aod2020Mean = aod2020.mean().multiply(0.001); // 5. Calculate mean AOD and pixel counts const stats2019 = await aod2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: gobiDesert, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = await aod2020Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: gobiDesert, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2019 = stats2019.Optical_Depth_047_mean; const count2019 = stats2019.Optical_Depth_047_count; const mean2020 = stats2020.Optical_Depth_047_mean; const count2020 = stats2020.Optical_Depth_047_count; console.log(`2019 AOD: ${mean2019}, Pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 AOD: ${mean2020}, Pixels: ${count2020}`); // 6. Validate results if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020) || mean2019 < 0 || mean2020 < 0 || mean2019 > 5 || mean2020 > 5) { console.log('Invalid AOD calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare and answer if (mean2020 > mean2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
